description: Save a search with the same filters as search_jobs. JustBacked emails new matching roles instantly (as soon as they reach JustBacked), daily or weekly.

alert.description: Default instant: an email as soon as new matches arrive.

cities.description: Metro areas: sf (SF Bay Area), nyc (New York), la (Los Angeles), bos (Boston), sea (Seattle), aus (Austin), den (Denver / Boulder), chi (Chicago), dc (Washington DC), mia (Miami), atl (Atlanta), sd (San Diego), lon (London), par (Paris), ber (Berlin), muc (Munich), tor (Toronto), sgp (Singapore), blr (Bengaluru), tlv (Tel Aviv), sto (Stockholm), ams (Amsterdam). Names work too.

countries.description: Country codes: us, gb, de, ca, fr, in, sg, au, es, nl, il, se, ch, ie, ae, jp.

exclude_title_words.description: Drop roles whose title contains any of these words, e.g. ["senior", "manager"].

functions.description: Job function: engineering (Engineering), product (Product), design (Design), data (Data & ML), sales (Sales & BD), marketing (Marketing), customer (Customer), operations (Operations), finance (Finance), people (People), legal (Legal), hardware (Hardware), science (Science), clinical (Clinical).

has_pay.description: Only roles that publish a salary range.

hiring_fast.description: Only companies that added 10+ roles in the last 30 days.

include_non_venture.description: Include debt, grants, PE and corporate rounds (default: venture rounds only).

list_id.description: Only companies on one of the user's lists (id from list_lists).

location.description: Free-text location match for places outside the metro list, e.g. "Portland".

min_pay_usd.description: Minimum published annual pay in USD (roles without published pay are excluded).

min_raise_usd.description: Minimum size of the latest round in USD, e.g. 20000000.

posted_within_hours.description: Only roles posted in the last N hours (24 or 48 shows the newest roles).

query.description: Keywords matched against job title, company and department, e.g. "product designer" or "founding engineer". Supports quotes and -exclusions.

raised_within_days.description: Only companies whose latest round is at most this many days old (e.g. 30).

search_descriptions.description: Also match query inside full job descriptions (broader, noisier).

seniority.description: Level: intern, entry, mid, senior, staff, manager, director, exec.

stages.description: Company's latest round: preseed (Pre-seed), seed (Seed), a (Series A), b (Series B), c (Series C), growth (Series D+), venture (Venture (series unknown)).

name: save_search
title: Save a search as an email alert
